parts.name: bottle shell

physics.Basic_description: The main cylindrical body of the dispenser, appearing as a cream-colored, ribbed plastic container with a matte finish.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the liquid contents and provides the primary structural volume for the object.
physics.Grasped_description: A parallel jaw gripper would grasp the mid-section of the cylinder firmly to lift or stabilize the object.
physics.reason: Standard blow-molded plastic bottles are thin-walled shells enclosing air or liquid, not solid blocks of plastic.

parts.description: The main cylindrical body of the dispenser, appearing as a cream-colored, ribbed plastic container with a matte finish.
parts.function: Holds the liquid contents and provides the primary structural volume for the object.

parts.name: front label

physics.Basic_description: A small, flat rectangular area on the side of the bottle, likely a printed label or sticker.
physics.Functional_description: Displays product information or branding on the exterior surface.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flush with the surface to be grasped independently; gripper would slip over it.
physics.reason: A label is a thin sheet of material that is effectively solid relative to its negligible thickness, lacking an enclosed void.

parts.description: A small, flat rectangular area on the side of the bottle, likely a printed label or sticker.
parts.function: Displays product information or branding on the exterior surface.

parts.name: collar shell

physics.Basic_description: A blue-tinted (in mask) or cream-colored (in RGB) threaded ring at the neck of the bottle.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the threading interface to secure the pump head or cap to the bottle body.
physics.Grasped_description: Could be grasped by the rim, but the small diameter makes it less stable than the body.
physics.reason: Injection molded screw caps/collars are hollow cylinders designed to fit over the bottle neck.

parts.description: A blue-tinted (in mask) or cream-colored (in RGB) threaded ring at the neck of the bottle.
parts.function: Provides the threading interface to secure the pump head or cap to the bottle body.

parts.name: pump head shell

physics.Basic_description: The top actuator component, appearing as a small cylindrical knob or head in the RGB view.
physics.Functional_description: The user-actuated part that depresses to dispense liquid through the mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: A gripper could pinch the top head to press down or lift, though it is small.
physics.reason: Pump heads are complex injection molded assemblies with internal chambers for springs and pistons, making them hollow shells.

parts.description: The top actuator component, appearing as a small cylindrical knob or head in the RGB view.
parts.function: The user-actuated part that depresses to dispense liquid through the mechanism.

parts.name: dip tube

physics.Basic_description: A long, thin, flexible tube extending from the bottom of the assembly, visible as a line in the RGB.
physics.Functional_description: Draws liquid from the bottom of the bottle up to the pump mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flexible to support the object's weight; would deform or slip under grip.
physics.reason: Dip tubes are narrow pipes that must be hollow to transport fluid.

parts.description: A long, thin, flexible tube extending from the bottom of the assembly, visible as a line in the RGB.
parts.function: Draws liquid from the bottom of the bottle up to the pump mechanism.

parts.name: spout shell

physics.Basic_description: A small protruding nozzle or tab on the side/top, colored purple in the mask.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the flow of dispensed liquid away from the bottle.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and fragile to serve as a primary grasp point; likely to break if squeezed hard.
physics.reason: Nozzles are tubular structures requiring a hollow interior for fluid passage.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
